control_parameter.name: target_initial_occupancy
control_parameter.definition: P(m >= matter_threshold) at step 0, imposed by a monotone piecewise-linear quantile map of U(0,1)
control_parameter.exactness_property: at p = 0.55 the map is the IDENTITY, so this arm is bit-identical to the frozen production initial condition _initial_state (m ~ U(0,1)); the sweep therefore contains the pilot regime as an exact special case
control_parameter.rationale: the frozen production IC hard-codes m ~ U(0,1) and the detector threshold is 0.45, hence occupancy is fixed at exactly 0.55; no law parameter of LatticeBondSpec controls occupancy

seed_labelling: DEV_FEASIBILITY_SWEEP_00, open, seeds 900000-999999 namespace, PERMANENTLY BANNED from any future primary or reproduction run

arms.ROUTE_E: quantile-mapped i.i.d. initial condition; p=0.55 is the production IC exactly
arms.SHUFFLED: same cell-value multiset, spatially permuted; identical cardinality and identical occupancy
arms.COMPACT_ISLANDS: positive control: disjoint compact discs above threshold on a sub-threshold background, equal occupancy
arms.SPANNING_BAND: negative morphological control: one band spanning the lattice, equal occupancy

engine_and_measurement.detector_tracker_residual: PRODUCTION, unmodified; no approximation is substituted
engine_and_measurement.law_spec: LatticeBondSpec(dt=1.0, m_max=1.0, n_max=1.0), remaining fields at frozen defaults
engine_and_measurement.measurement_spec: MeasurementSpec() defaults: matter_threshold=0.45, min_cells=3, dilation_radius=1, max_area_ratio=3.0, max_centroid_displacement=3.0

frozen_predicate_as_transcribed.criterion: at least one ELIGIBLE component satisfies persistence to the horizon AND cohort_residual <= f
frozen_predicate_as_transcribed.mechanical_ineligibility: any component wrapping the periodic boundary at any sampled frame makes the world MECHANICALLY_INELIGIBLE

declared_limitations: DEV horizon is 256 steps, not the frozen 1024: all 48 pilot worlds became mechanically ineligible by frame 48, so 256 is ample to observe the mechanism; this cannot change the sign of a null result and is therefore a DECLARED_LIMITATION

attainability uses the MINIMUM cohort_residual over all components at all sampled frames, an UPPER bound on what any tracker could achieve; a world whose minimum never reaches f cannot pass under any tracking, which is the direction needed for a negative conclusion
SHUFFLED is degenerate at t0 because the production IC is already i.i.d.; it is retained as a harness control, not as a correlation test
worlds within a level share the law and differ only by seed; they are not treated as independent draws
single_refinement_rule: at most one refinement pass between two adjacent promising levels; no third sweep
prospective_analytic_prediction: cohort_residual is bounded below by labelled_fraction = total_cohort/total_matter, because both are exactly conserved and mixing drives every local ratio to the global one; therefore f=0.20 is unreachable whenever labelled_fraction > 0.20, independently of occupancy, morphology and horizon
